business.text: Cipla operates 48 manufacturing facilities globally and maintains six state-of-the-art research and development centres. The company earns revenue through the sale of pharmaceutical products, recognizing sales when control of the product is transferred and recording amounts net of estimated discounts, returns, rebates, and other price adjustments. Its product portfolio spans major therapeutic areas, including a significant presence in respiratory treatments, chronic therapies, and domestic and international branded pharmaceuticals.
